components.title: supply-chain
components.description: Build pipeline that signs a SLSA provenance attestation and an SBOM for every released artifact, so a deployed image can be tied back to the trusted build that produced it and the components it contains can be inspected.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Every released artifact carries a SLSA provenance attestation from the trusted build pipeline.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: fabric provenance verifies a SLSA build-provenance attestation names the expected trusted builder, tying the artifact to its build.

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Every released artifact carries an SBOM whose component inventory contains no prohibited component.

props.name: Check_Description
props.value: fabric sbom checks a CycloneDX SBOM inventories the image's components and carries none banned by policy, so what is inside a deployed image is known and screened.

control-implementations.description: Build provenance attestation for the pharma MES baseline.

implemented-requirements.description: The ability to discern altered records: a SLSA provenance attestation ties each deployed artifact to the trusted pipeline that built it, so an artifact built outside that pipeline is detectable.

The ability to discern altered records: an SBOM inventories the components inside each deployed artifact and screens them against a prohibited-component policy, so an image carrying a banned component is detectable.
